tool: radare2 (aa, then linear pd $s and izz/search sweeps, no per-function af/aaa pass)
method: radare2, -a arm -b 32 -m 0x5ff00000 -e asm.bits=16. Virtual address = 0x5ff00000 + file offset, same DATA-tag-stripped body convention as iBSS_n90ap_4.3.1 -- base confirmed independently by its own boot-vector literal pool (same shape as LLB/iBSS/SecureROM), not assumed by analogy.
note: Apple's iBoot 4.3.1 for n90ap (iPhone 4), extracted from iPhone3,1_4.3.1_8G4_Restore.ipsw (Firmware/all_flash/all_flash.n90ap.production/iBoot.n90ap.RELEASE.img3) and decrypted through the device's own GID key (tools/decrypt_image3.sh), kept only under /tmp; never committed. Re-derive it with the same tool.
